It might be a good idea to fix to the correct version to reduce the likelihood of a wrong version being selected by an implementation/implementer, or use the [IG Parameter `pin-canonicals`](https://hl7.org/fhir/tools/CodeSystem-ig-parameters.html). Suggested fix: change the canonical reference from 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/condition-dueTo' to 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/condition-dueTo|5.3.0'

This SNOMED-CT based include has some concepts with semantic tags (FSN terms) and some without (preferred terms) - check that this is what is intended (examples for FSN: [Visual analog scale score (observable entity), Mini-mental state examination score (observable entity), Malnutrition universal screening tool score (observable entity), Norton pressure sore risk score (observable entity), Thirty second chair stand test score (observable entity)] and examples for no FSN: [FINDRISC (Finnish Diabetes Risk Score) score, Index of Independence in Activities of Daily Living, Pain Assessment in Advanced Dementia Scale, Subjective Global Assessment, Waterlow pressure sore risk score])
